name: memory.workspace.save
description: Save a memory scoped to the active workspace. Use this tool ONLY when the user has explicitly asked you to remember something for this specific workspace/project. Do NOT call this tool spontaneously — the system handles that automatically via a post-turn extraction pass. Workspace memory survives MRU eviction; the file index does not. Optionally pass entities[] to record graph relations.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Entity names to link in the knowledge graph (people, files, concepts).
